syncs.description: Make the available model catalog accessible as records keyed by full model endpoint ID, with descriptive metadata where the catalog supplies it.
syncs.name: sync-models

id.description: Stable full model endpoint ID, including owner, app, and any endpoint path.

name.description: Human-readable model name, when supplied by the catalog.

tags.description: Provider model tags in their original spelling and order; omitted when unavailable, empty when explicitly empty.

items.description: A provider model tag in its original spelling.

category.description: Provider's model category, without a locally imposed taxonomy; omitted when unavailable.

modelUrl.description: Provider-supplied model reference or playground URL, when available.

description.description: Provider's description of this model, when supplied.

Models.description: Available model catalog entry keyed by its full model endpoint ID, with provider-supplied descriptive metadata.

functions.name: cancel-request
functions.description: Remove a queued model request or ask its running model app to stop work. Returns the provider's cancellation disposition, not a guarantee that a running app has stopped.

modelId.description: Full model endpoint ID originally used for submission; endpoint suffixes are handled internally for cancellation.

requestId.description: Opaque request ID returned as id by submit-request.

FunctionInput_falai_cancelrequest.description: The original model endpoint and queued request to target for cancellation.

id.description: Opaque identifier of the request targeted for cancellation.

status.description: Provider cancellation disposition, preserved exactly. OK acknowledges the cancellation operation; CANCELLATION_REQUESTED means a stop was requested, not confirmed. ALREADY_COMPLETED and NOT_FOUND are retained if returned in a successful response. None implies reversal of completed effects.

modelId.description: Full model endpoint ID supplied for cancellation.

FunctionOutput_falai_cancelrequest.description: The targeted request and the provider cancellation disposition, without a guarantee that running work stopped.

tags.instructions: Use modelId and the id from `submit-request` to stop unwanted work. Queued work is removed; running work receives a cancellation signal and the app decides how to stop. This cannot undo completed work or promise a refund. A cancellation acknowledgement is not proof that execution stopped: inspect `get-request-status` and `get-request-result` afterward. The connection needs models:requests:cancel permission. Do not submit a confirmation flag.

functions.name: get-request-result
functions.description: Get the structured output of a completed model request, or report its model-validation, cancellation, timeout, or execution failure.

modelId.description: Full model endpoint ID used to submit this request. Any endpoint path is handled internally for the result lookup.

requestId.description: Opaque request ID returned as id by submit-request.

FunctionInput_falai_getrequestresult.description: The saved model endpoint and opaque request ID whose existing result should be read.

id.description: Opaque request identifier supplied for this result lookup.

additionalProperties.description: A model-specific JSON value, preserving nested objects, arrays, nulls and scalar values.

output.description: Parsed model output in the selected model's documented schema, including generated media references and structured values. This is model data, not an HTTP response envelope.

modelId.description: Full model endpoint ID supplied for this result lookup.

FunctionOutput_falai_getrequestresult.description: The existing request identity and its successful structured model output.

tags.instructions: Use the modelId and id saved from `submit-request`. Prefer `get-request-status` or `wait-for-request` first; COMPLETED alone does not prove success. This reads an existing result and never reruns the model. Retrieve output promptly: without extended payload storage, results expire after one hour, or six minutes for results at least 10 KB. The connection needs models:requests:read permission.

functions.name: get-request-status
functions.description: Get a model request's current lifecycle state, queue position, execution duration, failure information, and optional runner logs.

modelId.description: Full endpoint ID used to submit the request. Any endpoint suffix is handled internally for the status lookup.

requestId.description: Opaque request ID returned as id by submit-request.

includeLogs.description: Whether to request available runner logs. Some models do not provide logs even when requested.

FunctionInput_falai_getrequeststatus.description: Identify one submitted model request and optionally request its runner logs.

logs.description: Runner log entries when available. Null means the provider explicitly returned no log collection, for example when not requested; omission preserves an absent provider field. Empty array means an explicitly empty collection.

labels.description: Provider-supplied structured log labels; omitted when absent and empty when explicitly empty.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON value, including nested arrays, objects, and null.

message.description: Ordinary Unicode log message without transport encoding.

timestamp.description: Log event instant normalized to UTC with Z, preserving all supplied fractional-second precision.

items.description: One runner log event with its original message and optional structured labels.

status.description: Current lifecycle state. COMPLETED includes failed and cancelled requests and does not prove success.

modelId.description: Full endpoint ID supplied for this lookup, retained for follow-up tools.

errorType.description: Opaque provider failure category if reported; omitted when absent.

errorMessage.description: Provider's failure message if reported; omitted when absent.

queuePosition.description: Number of requests ahead, when reported for IN_QUEUE; omitted otherwise.

inferenceTimeSeconds.description: Reported runner execution duration in seconds, when available.

FunctionOutput_falai_getrequeststatus.description: Current request lifecycle snapshot, optional execution failure details, duration, and runner logs.

tags.instructions: Use modelId and the request id from `submit-request`. This is a single status lookup; use `wait-for-request` for a bounded wait. COMPLETED can mean success, failure, or cancellation: use `get-request-result` to obtain output or the execution error. Set includeLogs only when needed; not every model provides logs. The connection needs models:requests:read permission.

functions.name: list-models
functions.description: List one page of available models and their endpoint IDs for use when submitting model requests.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token returned by a previous call on this connection. Omit for the first page.

FunctionInput_falai_listmodels.description: Options for browsing one page of the model catalog.

id.description: Full model endpoint ID, including owner, app, and any endpoint path; usable as modelId in submit-request.

name.description: Human-readable model name, when supplied by the catalog.

tags.description: Provider's model tags, preserving order and spelling; omitted when unavailable and empty when explicitly empty.

items.description: A model tag in the provider's original spelling.

category.description: Provider's model category, preserved without imposing a local taxonomy; omitted when unavailable.

modelUrl.description: Provider-supplied model reference or playground URL, when available.

description.description: Provider's description of the model, when supplied.

items.description: A callable model endpoint and its available catalog metadata.
Models in this provider page, in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Omitted when no further page is available.

FunctionOutput_falai_listmodels.description: One provider page of available model endpoints with optional continuation state.

tags.instructions: Use this to discover model endpoint IDs before `submit-request`. Consult the selected model's API reference for its input schema; catalog entries do not necessarily include that schema. If nextCursor is returned, pass it as cursor to continue. This returns one provider page, not an exhaustive crawl.

functions.name: submit-request
functions.description: Submit model input for asynchronous execution and return the request identity and initial state. Supports both base models and nested endpoint paths, with optional queue, retry, storage, and app-owner controls.

additionalProperties.description: Model-specific input value, preserved as supplied.

input.description: Structured input matching the selected model's schema. Use ordinary text for prompts and the model's documented media fields; do not JSON-encode this object yourself.

modelId.description: Full endpoint ID from the model reference, including owner, app, and optional nested path, for example fal-ai/flux/schnell.

priority.description: Queue priority. Low lowers priority within the account; neither value raises account priority.

runnerHint.description: Best-effort runner-affinity hint for stateful workloads, such as a runner with a loaded LoRA. Omission leaves routing to fal.

retryCounts.description: Per-condition retry overrides, effective only when the connection owns the app. Cannot be combined with automaticRetries:false. Omitted conditions use provider behavior.

timeout.description: Requested number of retries for timeout failures.

serverError.description: Requested number of retries for temporary server failures.

connectionError.description: Requested number of retries for runner connection failures.

storePayloads.description: True requests default-period storage of input and output payloads; false disables it. Omit to use the account's storage setting.

maxQueueLength.description: Reject submission if this endpoint already has at least this many queued requests. Omit for the provider's unbounded queue default.

disableFallback.description: True asks the model app not to use a fallback model. This is forwarded to the app, not a guarantee that every app enforces it.

automaticRetries.description: Whether to allow fal's automatic retries for temporary runner failures. False disables them for this request.

startTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum elapsed seconds for work to start, including queue time and retries. Does not limit runner execution time. Omit for no request-specific start deadline.

outputFileExpirationSeconds.description: Requested lifetime in seconds for model-created files, independent of queue-result retention. Omit to leave lifecycle policy unchanged.

FunctionInput_falai_submitrequest.description: Model endpoint, structured model input, and optional asynchronous submission controls.

id.description: Opaque request identifier returned by fal; use as requestId in request tools.

status.description: Initial provider lifecycle state. COMPLETED includes success, failure, and cancellation, not just successful output.

modelId.description: Full submitted endpoint ID, retained for subsequent status, result, or cancellation calls.

errorType.description: Opaque provider failure category if supplied; omitted otherwise.

errorMessage.description: Provider failure message if the initial state already reports a failure; omitted otherwise.

queuePosition.description: Number of requests ahead of this request, when supplied for IN_QUEUE; zero means no requests ahead.

inferenceTimeSeconds.description: Runner execution duration in seconds when supplied, without unit conversion.

FunctionOutput_falai_submitrequest.description: Submission acknowledgement and initial lifecycle state, not confirmation of successful generation.

tags.instructions: Use this to start model work, not to wait for generation. Obtain a full model endpoint ID from `list-models` or the model's API reference, and supply input conforming to that model's schema. Save modelId and the returned id. Use `get-request-status` or `wait-for-request`, then `get-request-result`. Repeating submission can create another billable request. Custom retry counts apply only to apps you own. No completion webhook is registered.

functions.name: wait-for-request
functions.description: Wait for a model request to reach its terminal lifecycle state for at most 90 seconds, returning the latest status and optional logs even if execution is still ongoing.

modelId.description: Full model endpoint ID used for submission; endpoint suffixes are handled internally.

requestId.description: Opaque request ID returned as id by submit-request.

includeLogs.description: Whether to request available runner logs in the observed status. Some models provide none.

maxWaitSeconds.description: Maximum number of seconds spent on the bounded observation, including the initial status lookup. Defaults to 30; never waits for an arbitrarily long generation.

FunctionInput_falai_waitforrequest.description: Identify a submitted model request and bound the time spent observing its lifecycle.

logs.description: Log collection from the latest observation, preserving explicit null and empty arrays; omitted if that observation lacks the field.

labels.description: Structured provider log labels, omitted if absent and empty when explicitly empty.

additionalProperties.description: A JSON value, including nested arrays, objects, and null.

timestamp.description: Log instant normalized to UTC Z with all supplied fractional precision preserved.

items.description: One runner log entry from the latest status snapshot.

status.description: Latest observed lifecycle state. COMPLETED includes failure or cancellation and does not establish generation success.

modelId.description: Full endpoint ID supplied for this wait.

errorType.description: Opaque failure category in the latest observation, if supplied.

waitExpired.description: True when the bounded wait ended before COMPLETED was observed. False when a terminal state was observed.

errorMessage.description: Failure message in the latest observation, if supplied.

queuePosition.description: Number of requests ahead in the latest observation, if reported.

inferenceTimeSeconds.description: Runner execution duration in seconds if present in the latest observation.

FunctionOutput_falai_waitforrequest.description: The latest observed request snapshot, with whether the bounded wait expired before completion.

tags.instructions: Use this after `submit-request` when waiting briefly is more useful than an immediate `get-request-status` lookup. Save modelId and the request id before calling. Each call waits at most 90 seconds; if waitExpired is true, call again later or inspect status. COMPLETED includes failure and cancellation. Use `get-request-result` after completion. This does not cancel work when the wait expires and does not register notifications. Requires models:requests:read permission.
